messages:
Iris (marketing): Sprint check  we need a fresh battlecard for next month's webinar that clearly differentiates vs cloud AI APIs and infra vendors. Two lenses: 'Predictable Unit Economics' and 'Operational Control'. 2 bullets each + one-line rebuttal. Keep it micro.
Jon (growth): For economics, lead with a concrete customer example (tokens/session -> $/1k). People want a number they can relate to. Also suggest an ROI mini-calc on landing (3 fields max).
Kara (product): Quick bench drop: cached chat = $0.23/1k tokens; uncached ~ $0.66 (512 ctx, mixed load). Variant-fallback increased successful request rate ~2.9x during regional stress. I'll attach CSV to the doc.
opsbot: Bench artifact: https://redwood.internal/bench/3200 (internal)
Lloyd (sales): Objection snips: "Why not serverless?" -> "Serverless is great for dev but unpredictable at scale; Dedicated gives committed throughput, SLA, and clearer invoices." Also add a short non-branded competitor play: "lower unit economics at sustained throughput vs unmanaged endpoints."
Mina (content): I'll draft 3 slide hooks and 4 subject lines (two cost-first, two ops-first). Examples: 'Estimate your token bill in 30s' and 'Stop tail latency from breaking UX'. Need final bullets by 2pm.
Iris (marketing): Draft bullets  please edit: ```
Predictable Unit Economics:
- $0.23 / 1k tokens with prefix caching vs ~$0.66 uncached (bench)
- Committed Dedicated pricing + Optimize reduces invoice volatility and makes capacity planning simple
- Rebuttal: "Surprise charges?" -> "Console + ROI calc surface token-level and route-level cost forecasts"

Operational Control:
- Dedicated SLA reduces 99p latency jitter ~3x during congestion (bench)
- Smart routing + model-variant fallback keeps success rate high when regions are constrained
- Rebuttal: "Vendor lock-in?" -> "Portable model manifests and rollout controls let you run variants on Hosted, Dedicated, or Private"
```
Jon (growth): Swap econ bullets to lead with the dollar figure (price first). I'll wire the ROI calc A/B test: CTA A = "Estimate my token bill" vs CTA B = "See latency tail". Track roi-calc, bench-click, demo-request.
Kara (product): Note for SDRs: to hit the $0.23 number enable prefix caching + continuous batching in the runtime; turning caching off increases cost ~2.8x in our tests.
Lloyd (sales): I'll post two 1-line outreach opens (cost-first and ops-first) in 30m.
Iris (marketing): Action items: Kara paste CSV and confirm fallback stat (by noon); Mina deliver hooks + subjects (by 2pm); Jon run AB test; Lloyd draft outreach. I'll stitch the final battlecard and post in #docs when ready. :rocket:
